name: apprentorbay
description: ApprentorBay — Express API + Vite client. Deploy as a Node.js/Express web app (entry: app.js), not a static Vite site.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n emulators,client,server -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run emulators" "npm run dev -w client" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:8080 tcp:127.0.0.1:9099 && npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build:workspaces: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
